statistical_protocol.resampling: paired log-cluster percentile bootstrap; window-weighted mean
statistical_protocol.event_aggregation: unique anchor within each label; unweighted mean across supported labels
statistical_protocol.note: No log-level CI without an authoritative evaluation.log_map; no inference of log IDs from DB names.

collision_protocol.disabled_reason: Set evaluation.ego_footprint: [front, rear, left, right] in metres
collision_protocol.definition: fraction of complete windows with >=1 oriented-footprint overlap against logged objects
collision_protocol.detection: discrete target timestamps; boundary contact counts; no swept detection
collision_protocol.objects: all annotated categories; no ground-truth-collision exclusions
collision_protocol.annotation_time_matching: absolute timestamp difference <= tolerance; offline annotations may precede or follow targets, never policy inputs

protocol.observations: History, then arrived BEV at each 0.1 s decision; no future action inputs
protocol.aggregation: unique-anchor mean; ade_m uses valid prefix, ade_full_horizon_m/FDE require complete horizon; fixed-horizon main tables use ade_full_horizon_m
protocol.displacement_metrics: metrics.displacement; one ego, one mode; missing values excluded
protocol.constant_action_baseline: repeat the final pre-anchor local SE(2) action
protocol.units: positions and displacement errors: metres; headings: radians

timing.note: Cached-BEV whole-window batch forward after warmup; excludes encoder, transfers and loading. Neither single-decision nor end-to-end latency.
